answer: Attestation is two-sided: to attest you must also be attestable, and a mutual pair that only ever attests each other is detected and voided. The jetty edge is entered both ways, so a closed ring of 170 clones produces a signature the vault analysis flags immediately. Anyone must as a result build an open graph reaching real agents, thus doing work rather than printing keys, and the nadir settlement applies the void retroactively. That is 24 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
